slo_title: Develop programs to implement FCFS and SJF scheduling algorithms

mcq.q: In FCFS algorithm, if the CPU is idle and the next process hasn’t arrived yet, what happens?

options.A: The process with shortest burst time is selected
options.B: CPU is allocated to another process
options.C: CPU remains idle until the next process arrives
options.D: Current time is reset to zero

mcq.answer_text: CPU remains idle until the next process arrives

mcq.q: In SJF implementation, which condition allows a process to be selected for execution?

options.D: Arrival time ≤ current time AND isCompleted = false

mcq.answer_text: Arrival time ≤ current time AND isCompleted = false
